scope: root eBPF trace_exec, synthetic executable comm only, no process args
limitations: host-level capture with kernel filter --comm and --uid; filter correctness checked by negative control
tracer emits only comm,pid,parent.pid,uid,timestamp, no args
baseline and tracer loops are sequential, not randomized; timing deltas descriptive
kernel map/link inventory and per-event loss counter were not measured
systemwide CPU/RAM/IO and production DBA impact were not measured
